items.source: use of PathMatcher and UrlPathHelper is deprecated for use at runtime in web modules in favor of parsed patterns with PathPatternParser.
items.translation: 使用 `PathMatcher` 和 `UrlPathHelper` 在运行时于 Web 模块中已被弃用，转而使用由 `PathPatternParser` 解析的模式。

items.source: Pattern matching can be done with a PathMatcher or with pre-parsed PathPatterns. The syntax is largely the same with the latter being more tailored for web usage and more efficient. The choice depends on the presence of a resolved String lookupPath or a parsed RequestPath with a fallback on PathMatcher but the fallback can be disabled. For more details, please see setAllowInitLookupPath(boolean).
items.translation: 可以使用PathMatcher或预解析的PathPatterns 进行模式匹配。后者的语法大体相同，但更适用于 Web 使用场景且效率更高。选择取决于是否存在已resolved的 String lookupPath 或带有parsed RequestPath的 fallback 到PathMatcher，但可禁用该 fallback。有关更多详细信息，请参阅setAllowInitLookupPath(boolean)。

items.source: By default this is set to true in which case lazy lookupPath initialization is allowed. Set this to false when an application is using parsed PathPatterns in which case the RequestPath can be parsed earlier via ServletRequestPathFilter.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值设置为 true，此时允许延迟初始化 lookupPath。当应用程序使用解析后的 PathPatterns 时，将此值设置为 false，此时可以通过 ServletRequestPathFilter 更早地解析 RequestPath。

items.source: For pattern syntax see AntPathMatcher and PathPattern as well as class-level Javadoc for details on which one may in use. Generally the syntax is largely the same with PathPattern more tailored for web usage.
items.translation: 有关模式语法，请参阅AntPathMatcher和PathPattern，以及有关哪个可能正在使用的类级别 Javadoc 详细信息。通常语法大体相同，PathPattern更适用于 Web 使用。

items.source: Note: Setting PathMatcher enforces use of String pattern matching even when a parsed RequestPath is available.
items.translation: 注意： 设置 PathMatcher 会强制使用字符串模式匹配，即使存在已解析的 parsed RequestPath。

items.source: In Spring MVC, either a resolved String lookupPath or a parsed RequestPath is always available within DispatcherServlet processing. However, in a Servlet Filter such as CorsFilter that may or may not be the case.
items.translation: 在 Spring MVC 中，`DispatcherServlet` 处理过程中始终存在解析后的 String 类型的 `lookupPath` 或已解析的 `RequestPath`。然而，在某些 Servlet `Filter`（例如可能不一定具备此特性的 `CorsFilter`）中，情况则未必如此。
